title: Wingdings font
description: This font is the popular "wingdings" font, not using the english alphabet, but instead of bunch of random, slightly related symbols!
body: The popular font wingdings, now implemented into minecraft. If the pack is causing performance issues, extract the zip, go to assets\minecraft\font\default.json and change the bottom parameter. higher number = higher fidelity, but minecraft has a hard time with fonts, so I don't recommend going above 3.5.
